title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I’m gonna throw some shade at Caputo
A) “There is an actual tweet on this website titled “Pat Caputo: Max Scherzer Is Out Of Touch” and I’m sorry I ever left you, Twitter.”
B ) “Today’s recommended reading: ‘Max Scherzer Is Out Of Touch,’ by Pat Caputo.”
I don’t know what it’s about, nor do I have time to investigate and review for ya today. My only advice is that you shouldn’t do anything unnecessary
Not gonna lie, it felt real good to ignore your advice
“I can’t let Greg run this Twitter account. It is unnecessary but sometimes, I’m unnecessary.”
